name: cyclopts-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `cyclopts`, a Python library that builds command-line interfaces
from type hints: an `App` registers commands and sub-apps, binds command-line tokens to
positional, keyword and variadic function parameters, coerces them to the annotated types,
applies `Parameter` and `Group` configuration and validators, reads values from environment
variables and configuration files, runs the command and handles its result, and renders help
pages.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the cyclopts command-line parsing library other than shell completion, the Sphinx and MkDocs extensions, the CLI documentation generators and the bundled cyclopts command: every module under cyclopts/ except cyclopts/completion/, cyclopts/ext/, cyclopts/docs/, cyclopts/cli/, cyclopts/sphinx_ext.py, cyclopts/_edit.py and cyclopts/__main__.py, together with README.md, the documentation pages under docs/source/ named getting_started, app_calling, commands, command_chaining, parameters, default_parameter, args_and_kwargs, rules, user_classes, groups, group_validators, parameter_validators, config_file, meta_app, help, help_customization, version, autoregistry, lazy_loading, known_issues and api, every page under docs/source/cookbook/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules, including their examples.
